title: The Thirst of Dustglen
prose:
1. Find Master Marlo Vance in the ruins of the Redstone Canyons.
The wells of Dustglen have run bone-dry, leaving the villagers desperate. Only the eccentric Ironwright engineer, Marlo Vance, knows how to unseal the ancient aqueducts.

2. Recover the Obsidian Key from the Sunken Vault's guardian.
Marlo agrees to help but reveals the cistern's intake valve is locked by an ancient mechanism. A rogue stone sentinel in the nearby ravines holds the key needed to turn the gears.

3. Deliver the Brass Regulator to the Sunken Vault of Eld and repair the main valve.
With the key secured, Marlo provides a custom-forged Brass Regulator to replace the rusted components. You must descend into the dark, dusty depths of the vault to install it.

4. Defend the cistern's release lever from attracted desert scavengers while the pressure builds.
As the ancient gears grind to life, the scent of fresh water draws aggressive dune-stalkers from the surrounding wastes. Hold them off until the life-giving torrent floods back into Dustglen's reservoirs.
